tools.name: kiotviet_list_products
tools.description: List products (code, barcode, name, category, base price, units, attributes). Optionally include stock per branch (include_inventory) and price-book prices. Filter by name, category, branch, active flag or last change. GET /products.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_product
tools.description: One product by id: code, barcode, name, category, base price, units, attributes, images, stock per branch and price books. GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_product_by_code
tools.description: One product by its product code (SKU). GET /products/code/{code}.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_categories
tools.description: List product categories (id, name, parent, whether it has children). Set hierarchical to get the category tree. GET /categories.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_category
tools.description: One product category by id (name, parent, children). GET /categories/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (code, name, phone, email, address, debt, total invoiced, reward points, groups). Contains personal data of the shop's customers. Filter by code, name, phone, group or last change. GET /customers.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by id: contact data, debt, total invoiced, reward points, groups. GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_customer_by_code
tools.description: One customer by customer code. GET /customers/code/{code}.

tools.name: kiotviet_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a new customer in the shop (name required; code is generated by KiotViet if omitted). Always check with the user first, and look the customer up by phone before creating a duplicate. POST /customers.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices (code, date, branch, customer, total, amount paid, status, lines). Filter by branch, customer, status, order, purchase-date range or last change. GET /invoices.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_invoice
tools.description: One invoice by id with its lines, payments and delivery. GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_invoice_by_code
tools.description: One invoice by invoice code (for example HD000123). GET /invoices/code/{code}.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_orders
tools.description: List sales orders (code, date, branch, customer, total, status, lines, delivery). Filter by branch, customer, status, creation date (from) or last change (from/to). GET /orders.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_order
tools.description: One sales order by id with its lines, payments and delivery. GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_order_by_code
tools.description: One sales order by order code (for example DH000123). GET /orders/code/{code}.

tools.name: kiotviet_create_order
tools.description: WRITE: create a sales order (an order, not an invoice: no invoice is made and no payment is recorded) with lines of existing products in a branch, for an existing customer or none. Always confirm the products, quantities and prices with the user first. POST /orders.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_branches
tools.description: List the shop's branches (id, name, code, phone, address). Use the ids to filter other tools. GET /branches.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_stock
tools.description: Stock on hand and reserved quantity per product and branch. Filter by branch or last change. GET /productOnHands.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers (code, name, phone, email, address, debt, total invoiced). Filter by code, name, phone or last change. GET /suppliers.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_supplier
tools.description: One supplier by id. GET /suppliers/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List goods receipts from suppliers (nhap hang: code, date, branch, supplier, total, lines). Filter by branch, status or purchase-date range. GET /purchaseorders.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_purchase_order
tools.description: One goods receipt (nhap hang) by id with its lines. GET /purchaseorders/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_supplier_orders
tools.description: List orders placed with suppliers (dat hang nhap: code, date, branch, supplier, status, lines, amount paid). Filter by branch, status, supplier or product text. GET /ordersuppliers.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_returns
tools.description: List customer returns (code, date, branch, customer, invoice, return total, lines). GET /returns.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_return
tools.description: One customer return by id with its lines. GET /returns/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_cashflow
tools.description: List cash-book entries (receipts and payments: code, branch, method, partner, amount, date, status). Filter by branch, direction or date range. GET /cashflow.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_users
tools.description: List the shop's staff users (id, username, name, phone, email). GET /users.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_price_books
tools.description: List price books (bang gia: name, active flag, validity dates, branches, customer groups). GET /pricebooks.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_price_book
tools.description: The product prices of one price book (product id, code, price), paged. GET /pricebooks/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kiotviet_list_customers, kiotviet_create_customer, kiotviet_list_suppliers, kiotviet_list_users · Private data: kiotviet_get_customer · Public sink: kiotviet_list_customers, kiotviet_create_customer, kiotviet_create_order, kiotviet_list_suppliers, kiotviet_list_users.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kiotviet_list_customers, kiotviet_create_customer, kiotviet_list_suppliers, kiotviet_list_users · Private data: kiotviet_get_customer · Public sink: kiotviet_list_customers, kiotviet_create_customer, kiotviet_create_order, kiotviet_list_suppliers, kiotviet_list_users

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
